examples.title: A complete flow
examples.description: Continue draws a completion check and fills the next connector. Back reverses the motion. Set currentStep to steps.length to finish, then restart. The optional navigation=completed mode permits only completed-step actions.

examples.title: Vertical steps
examples.description: Use a vertical layout for a sidebar or a narrow form. The connector fills from top to bottom and descriptions wrap beside each marker.

examples.title: Custom icons
examples.description: With marker=icon, custom icons remain visible after completion. Steps without a custom icon use a dot that becomes a drawn check.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Small markers are 24px and medium markers are 28px. Both keep a 2px connector and a 4px current-step halo.

examples.title: Direct navigation
examples.description: Existing behavior is unchanged: onStepChange makes all enabled steps clickable. Arrow keys and Home/End move focus; Enter or Space activates the focused step.

examples.title: Unavailable steps
examples.description: Disable an individual step or the entire stepper. Disabled actions cannot receive focus or fire onStepChange; keyboard navigation skips them.

examples.title: Read-only progress
examples.description: Omit onStepChange to show a labelled ordered list without buttons. aria-current=step identifies the current position.

examples.title: Right to left
examples.description: dir=rtl mirrors horizontal connector placement and fill direction. Arrow navigation follows the visual direction.
